verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI-agent observability platform like Bento, but nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core product. Traces are exported to Bento's endpoint, and the CLI authenticates against the hosted service. Storing skills and rules as Markdown/YAML in your repo, and running alongside an existing observability stack, are adjacent features, not self-hosting of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
